turns.question: What was the median gap in hours between consecutive orders of the same customer in September 2026, counting only customers with at least two orders?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the time between a customer's consecutive orders (median or otherwise), so I cannot give that figure for September 2026. The closest metrics are Repeat customers (repeat_customers: distinct customers with a non-cancelled order in the period who have placed two or more orders in all), Orders (orders_total) and Active customers (customers_distinct); I can query any of these for September 2026 if useful.
